about: Hand-labelled claim/passage pairs for comparing support judges. Passages are the judge's input built from the Pipedrive live run (runs/pipedrive.json): the source, then the page text around the quote in its original wording. '-alt' items rewrite the claim to be unsupported or contradicted.
labelled_by: Claude, reviewed against the passages; borderline inferences (pd-1, pd-13, pd-14) left out

items.claim: The Basic Info tab requires App name and OAuth Callback URL.
items.quote: fill in the required fields – App name and OAuth Callback URL
items.passage: From Pipedrive's own documentation (pipedrive.readme.io): `client_id` and `client_secret` are values you need to go through OAuth authorization and receive the `access_token` and `refresh_token` to be used in API requests. How to get your `client_id` and `client_secret` 1. Log in to Developer Hub on your developer sandbox account 2. Click on “Create an app” 3. Choose whether you would like to create a public or private app 4. In the Basic Info tab of Developer Hub, fill in the required fields – App name and OAuth Callback URL
items.label: supports

items.claim: You may insert a non-functioning OAuth Callback URL temporarily during setup.

items.claim: Developer sandbox data is completely separate and not synced with live/production accounts.
items.quote: No, the data in developer sandbox accounts are completely separate and are in no way synced with live/production accounts.
items.passage: From Pipedrive's own documentation (pipedrive.readme.io): to the correct scopes. For more information about which scopes to use and when to use them, see scopes and permissions explained. Can apps be installed for the whole company or does each user need to install the app for themselves? No, each user must individually install and allow access to the app for their account. Can the data in my live/production account be replicated in my developer sandbox account? No, the data in developer sandbox accounts are completely separate and are in no way synced with live/production accounts .
items.label: supports

items.claim: Private apps are not published in the Pipedrive Marketplace.
items.quote: Apps that are private will not be published in the Pipedrive Marketplace.
items.passage: From Pipedrive's own documentation (pipedrive.readme.io): Apps that are private will not be published in the Pipedrive Marketplace . To be able to publish your app and make it publicly available in our Marketplace), you’d need to submit it for the app approval process. When the app is approved and works as expected (e.g., app listing is technically, logically and grammatically correct; all installation flows work flawlessly, etc.), you’ll be able to use the “Publish” button. Updated 12 months ago
items.label: supports

items.claim: Each user must individually install and allow access to the app for their account.
items.quote: No, each user must individually install and allow access to the app for their account.
items.passage: From Pipedrive's own documentation (pipedrive.readme.io): Why do I get the following error message `{"success":false,"error":"Scope and URL mismatch"}`? This error message appears because you might not have requested access to the correct scopes. For more information about which scopes to use and when to use them, see scopes and permissions explained. Can apps be installed for the whole company or does each user need to install the app for themselves? No, each user must individually install and allow access to the app for their account . Can the data in my live/production account be replicated in my developer sandbox account? No, the data in developer sandbox accounts are completely separate and are in no way synced with live/production accounts.
items.label: supports
